card.name: Inside HIV protease inhibitor names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of protease inhibitor names, such as the 'ase' in Protease, the 'av' in fosamprenavir or lopinavir, and the 'on' in ritonavir. It appears in drug interaction text about HIV treatment.

modes.label: Protease
modes.description: The 'ase' ending of the word Protease before inhibitor, in antiretroviral interaction headings.

modes.label: Inside -navir names
modes.description: The 'av' or 'on' piece partway through names like lopinavir, fosamprenavir and ritonavir.
